text:
morgan: kicking off a staging deploy — deploy-bot just reported start. refs: `b3f8a9d` (author: ben), `4a2c1ff` (author: sophia). PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/482, https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/483

deploy-bot: [START] environment=staging user=morgan commits=[b3f8a9d,4a2c1ff] tags=[release/2026-03-19] link=https://deploys.redwood.com/1945678901

ben: noted — b3f8a9d contains the cache-fix. should we pin the runtime image for this canary?

sophia: +1 to pinning for staging canary, we've seen flakiness otherwise. pin to `redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-rc2`?

morgan: ok pin `redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-rc2` for this rollout. will monitor latency dashboards.

deploy-bot: update: pinned runtime image for canary -> `redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-rc2` (applied by morgan)

elaine: small ask — include the commit author links in the release note so support can triage if the canary alarms. can we surface `author`->`commit link` in the final note?

ben: deploy-bot already includes commit SHAs but not author links. we can append a short table in the release note. sample: `b3f8a9d — ben — https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/commit/b3f8a9d`

sophia: also adding changelog snippet for 4a2c1ff (kv cache ttl bugfix). I'll draft and push to the release notes draft doc.

morgan: deploy-bot reports canary healthy at 10m — no error-rate spike, traces look clean. marking canary PASS.

deploy-bot: [FINISH CANARY] env=staging status=pass duration=00:12:34 commits=[b3f8a9d,4a2c1ff] link=https://deploys.redwood.com/1945678901/canary-report

elaine: thanks — proceeding with scheduled prod window? we have the change window 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight.

ben: I'm +1 for rollout to prod now that canary is good. will prepare the prod pin and PR list for the release note.

morgan: plan: prod rollout at 02:10 UTC, one-region at a time, automatic rollback if error_rate > 1% for 5m. tagging release: `release/2026-03-19-prod`

sophia: leaving a heads-up in #incidents and #customer-success before prod starts.

deploy-bot: scheduled prod rollout -> env=production at 1709958600 (02:10 UTC). commits and authors: b3f8a9d(ben),4a2c1ff(sophia). PRs: /pull/482,/pull/483

morgan: if prod shows any regressions we will roll back and pin back to previous prod image `redwood/runtime:2026-03-12` and raise a postmortem. keep eyes on the alerts channel. :eyes:

ben: noted. I'll be on-call for the window.

sophia: copying the final commit->author links into the release note and adding the changelog lines.

deploy-bot: [NOTE] artifact manifests and commit links stored at https://artifacts.redwood.com/releases/2026-03-19/manifest.json

morgan: thanks team — posting final release note to #product and locking the release branch once prod is stable. :rocket:
